A_inventory_and_provenance.details: Three independent COD CIFs are present, parsed and SHA-256 pinned. RRUFF R050045 and R060745 are verified adaptation_pool inputs with manifest hash checks. Independent CaF2/rutile CIF bytes could not be fetched, so these compositions remain unsupported candidates.

B_headless_physics_and_refinement.details: Synthetic end-to-end tests identify and recover all three bundled CIFs. Corrected RRUFF source wavelength #1 gives MgO as the top candidate for both samples; overlays show profile mismatch, and the R060745 MgO fit hits the 60-evaluation cap. Neither run validates the model because CaF2/rutile candidates are unavailable.

C_optional_frozen_classifier.details: A local frozen Dynamic-JS checkpoint was verified by SHA-256 and strict model/config load, then inferred on both adaptation examples at the exact simulator CuKa wavelength. The top output was triclinic for both despite cubic/tetragonal manifest labels. The optional prior is off by default and never filters candidates.

D_streamlit_uploader_and_plot.details: The uploader and local adaptation-only RRUFF selector share the measured-versus-fit/residual plot. Streamlit 1.66.0 started headlessly from the isolated venv and /_stcore/health returned HTTP 200 ok. No browser visual inspection was performed.

E_tests_demo_docs_and_delivery.details: Twelve deterministic unittest cases passed (including local RRUFF and checkpoint inference checks), along with compileall, JSON parsing, diff check and ignored-overlay verification. Three simulated demos remain. Metadata-only RRUFF audit and regenerated ignored local overlays are recorded. Branch commit and push are pending; no PR or merge is requested.
